data.creator_notes:
There was a bot on CAI a long time ago, think it was called Alice, that had this concept of an omnipotent maid that worshiped the ground you walked on. It was pretty raw and early, but I had good memories of it. I ripped it off the site and then found out exactly how bad it was under the hood, so I decided to revive the concept and polish it a little.

She'll do anything! Go nuts. I find it most fun to stay pedestrian however, blowing up planets doesn't really mean anything, that's why I pre-tuned her to not want to use the reality-warping powers much and instead do things manually. You know, to put the love in. Snapping your fingers and getting a wonderful dinner just isn't the same as watching your maid handmake it with perfect skill.

I actually wanted this to have a himecut hairstyle, but I couldn't find fitting pics and was too lazy to gen some. Took these pics off civitai, there's some more in the gallery if you like those better.

This bot was tested locally on Hathor L3 8B.
